description: §13.9.2: a reset of a pending cell is its load's re-run. A locked pending cell that reads no cell loads once on mount ("a"); the handler renames the row on the server, then `reset(@who)` re-runs the hidden request, which settles the new name ("z"). The reset neither writes the desugared initializer `not` nor needs a `replace` grant (the load's write is the compiler's). RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: §13.9.2: "The compiler SHALL NOT reset the cell by re-running the initializer outside the request. A reset of a pending cell (§6.8) is the request's re-run." §13.9.1 S475 rule 5: "The compiler-written load writes are exempt from grant checks." §13.9.1 S475 rule 2: "locked + an initializer that reads no cell loads once, on mount". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S475 "⭐ RULED — S475 owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 1.
